# Caitlin Stamatis, PhD
> Licensed clinical psychologist and digital-health researcher. Health-tech clinical consulting and evidence-based individual therapy. Former research lead at Slingshot AI, Google, Akili Interactive, and Otsuka.

## About
- [About](https://drstamatis.com/about.html): Bio, credentials, and experience (Slingshot AI, Google, Akili Interactive, Otsuka; PhD University of Miami; residency Weill Cornell Medicine)

## Services
- [Services](https://drstamatis.com/services.html): Health-tech clinical consulting (clinical strategy, research design, content & safety review, workshops) and virtual individual therapy. Licensed in NY, NJ, and 40+ PSYPACT states.

## Credibility
- [Research](https://drstamatis.com/research.html): 50+ peer-reviewed publications on digital mental health, AI safety in mental health, digital therapeutics, anxiety, and depression
- [Press & Speaking](https://drstamatis.com/press.html): Media commentary and 30+ invited talks (Wellcome Trust, APA, SDMH, ABCT)
- [Writing](https://drstamatis.com/blog.html): Essays on clinical evidence in health tech

## Contact
- [Contact](https://drstamatis.com/contact.html): Consulting, therapy, and speaking inquiries

## Topics
Digital mental health, AI safety in mental health, digital therapeutics, clinical evidence standards, ADHD, anxiety, depression, workplace mental health.
